quote: In their Experiment 1, Griskevicius et al. (2013) showed 168 participant images ... In the experiment that follows, we sought to replicate this effect ... We attempted to replicate the effect of mortality salience on delay discounting reported by Kelley and Schmeichel (2015). ... In this experiment we sought to replicate the results reported by Bulley et al. (2019).
notes: Bulley et al. is cited as 2019 (QJEP print year); the list entry @bulley2018 has the identical title (online-first year). Griskevicius 2011 (@griskevicius2011) is background only.
